name: Don Bacon
stance: Wants AI development closely monitored with guardrails if warranted, but warns that regulating AI now would cost the US the race with China.

statements.text: Co-led, with Reps. Gottheimer and Suozzi, a bipartisan letter to Elon Musk asking xAI to explain what in Grok's training or programming caused its antisemitic and violent posts.
Having Nvidia providing this technology to China is a mistake.
They have much higher technology, they are using AI, which gives you a lot more capability at finding weaknesses in your adversaries’ cyber-defenses.
Praised University of Nebraska Omaha NCITE researchers for demonstrating on Capitol Hill how terrorists can exploit jailbroken AI.
At the same time, we should closely monitor AI development & be prepared to put in guardrails if warranted. But, over regulating AI now is a recipe for defeat.
